summary: Verified all reported bug fixes for GOJUNIORS e-commerce. Both issues are now resolved: 1) Categories page correctly displays subcategory_count and product_count for each category, 2) Admin Products page shows dynamic category names with icons (not hardcoded), 3) Product category changes are properly saved and reflected in the products list.

issues: Category dropdown shows 'Select category' instead of current category when editing - categoryPath not persisted in database. This is a UX issue but doesn't affect functionality.

passed_tests: Backend API GET /api/categories returns enriched data with subcategory_count and product_count
Categories page displays summary stats: Main Categories count, Total Subcategories count, Total Listings count
Each category row shows 'X subcategories' and 'X direct / Y total listings'
Stats badges show 'X sub' and 'X items' for categories with children/products
Admin Products page shows dynamic category names with icons (e.g., '👶 Children', '👕 Clothes', '🧸 Toys')
Category column is NOT hardcoded - dynamically fetches from categories array
Product edit page opens category modal with all available categories
Category change from 'Children' to 'Toys' saved successfully
Category change reflected immediately in products list after save
Admin login with credentials (admin@gojuniors.com / admin123) works
critical_code_review_comments: Minor UX: When editing a product, the category dropdown shows 'Select category' instead of the current category name because categoryPath is not stored in the database. Consider populating categoryPath from the category name when loading the product for editing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All reported bugs are fixed. Categories API returns enriched data with counts. AdminProducts.jsx line 394-397 now dynamically shows category name+icon from categories array. AdminCategories.jsx displays subcategory_count and product_count for each category. Product category changes are saved and reflected correctly. Note: Product 'Cute Dinosaur T-Shirt' was changed from 'Children' to 'Toys' during testing - may need to be reverted if needed.
